findings: Preserved original publication date 2025-02-27, removed the conflicting injected date, and set lastmod 2026-11-23 in all editions.
Clarified that the example uses Gmail SMTP rather than the Gmail API and that OAuth 2.0 is preferred when supported.
Documented app-password prerequisites and availability caveats; replaced inline password placeholders with curl’s interactive password prompt.
Added an RFC 5322 message file, Bash and Windows PowerShell commands, implicit TLS on port 465, STARTTLS on port 587, sender-address consistency, and credential-handling guidance.
scope: Read the full Japanese article and all twelve translations. Compared Gmail SMTP endpoint/ports and OAuth support, app-password policy, curl prompt behavior and SMTP upload format with official primary docs.

meaning.note: Read the complete Japanese article and complete localized edition. Compared SMTP setup, authentication caveats, account eligibility, message formatting, sender identity, TLS mode, password prompting, and credential-safety guidance.
